title.en: O, En Samakala Thozharkale! (ஓ, என் சமகாலத் தோழர்களே!)

text.en: A poet speaks directly to the people of his own time.

This poem is addressed to the poet's contemporaries (சமகாலத் தோழர்கள்). It calls them to think, act and build a better world together. It is a memorisation poem in the book.
The poem uses a direct, forceful voice that urges people to change and not to wait.
Terms: சமகாலம் (the present age), தோழர் (comrade), கவிதை (poem) and மனப்பாடம். Read the poem in your textbook for its exact lines.
